q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance (Revenue)

## (a) Time left until resolution
8 days (earnings release scheduled for August 26, 2026; current date is August 18, 2026)

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has just provided forward guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027 in their Q1 FY2027 earnings release (May 20, 2026). This means the guidance range is $89.18B to $92.82B.

The current research explicitly states this is the forward guidance that was already released. Since the earnings date is 8 days away, the question is asking what forward guidance will be provided at that upcoming earnings call.

Key facts:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6B
- Q1 FY2027 Data Center revenue: $75.2B (92% of total)
- Q2 FY2027 forward guidance already issued: $91.0B ± 2%
- Q1 to Q2 sequential growth in Q2 would be 11.5% at the midpoint

The forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 has already been publicly provided at $91.0B ± 2%. Unless there is a material change warranting revised guidance before the earnings call, NVIDIA typically reiterates its previously issued guidance.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Major data center weakness or customer pullback between May and August 2026
- Significant deterioration in AI demand indicators
- Unexpected competitive pressure from alternative solutions
- China-related revenue headwinds worse than expected (already excluded from guidance)
- Customer inventory corrections or delayed spending

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected demand for AI chips and accelerators
- Larger-than-anticipated customer TAM expansion
- Successful Vera CPU ramp contributing more than the anticipated $20B annual guidance
- Market share gains vs. competitors
- Higher-than-expected pricing power

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the exact forward guidance already issued: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which equates to a range of $89.18B to $92.82B with a midpoint of $91.0B.

Historical context from the data:
- Q1 FY2027 to Q2 FY2027 implied growth: ~11.5% quarter-over-quarter at the midpoint of guidance
- This is slower than the 20% Q-o-Q growth from Q4 to Q1, suggesting potential deceleration
- Data Center unit momentum remains strong but may be moderating from prior exceptional growth rates

---

## Reasoning

Since the forward guidance of $91.0B ± 2% has already been explicitly released (May 20, 2026) and is publicly available on investor.nvidia.com, the question is whether NVIDIA will restate this same guidance at the August 26 earnings call or provide a new/revised guidance.

In typical practice, companies restate previously issued forward guidance unless material changes have occurred. With only 8 days until the earnings call and no indication of changed circumstances, the guidance is most likely to be reiterated at or very close to the $91.0B midpoint.

The ±2% range ($89.18B-$92.82B) provides the natural bounds of expectation around the $91.0B midpoint.

**Median estimate: $91.0 billion** (restatement of existing guidance)

The 10th-90th percentile range accounts for:
- Small probability of revised guidance (up or down)
- Natural variance around the stated midpoint
- Potential for slight beat/miss narrative that might lead to modest adjustments

Low (10th percentile): 88950000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 93200000000
q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, is \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook explicitly does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance is below the average analyst estimate of \$91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). For comparison, NVIDIA reported a record revenue of \$81.6 billion in Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% increase quarter-over-quarter [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The Data Center unit accounted for 92% of total sales in Q1 FY2027, reaching \$75.2 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). CFO Colette Kress anticipates \$20 billion in total CPU revenue this fiscal year, driven by the new Vera CPU [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA will report its Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026 [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
